components.name: 前翼
components.does: 引导前端气流，并产生前部下压力。
components.why: 影响前轴抓地与整车空气动力平衡。
en: Front Wing
Multi-element wings at the front of the car.
Guide airflow and generate front downforce.
Affect front grip and aerodynamic balance.

components.name: 鼻锥
components.what: 位于座舱前方的细长车身结构。
components.does: 连接前部车身，并影响周围气流路径。
components.why: 形状与前翼、底盘布局相互关联。
en: Nose
The narrow body structure ahead of the cockpit.
Connects the forward body and influences nearby airflow.
Works with the front wing and chassis layout.

components.name: 前悬架
components.what: 连接前轮与底盘的连杆系统。
components.does: 约束车轮运动并传递载荷。
components.why: 影响轮胎接地与车身姿态。
en: Front Suspension
Links connecting the front wheels to the chassis.
Control wheel motion and transmit loads.
Influence tyre contact and car attitude.

components.name: 前轮
components.does: 承担转向、制动和横向力传递。
components.why: 抓地表现受温度、胎压和磨损等因素影响。
en: Front Tyres
The front tyre and wheel assemblies.
Transmit steering, braking and lateral forces.
Grip depends on temperature, pressure and wear, among other factors.

components.name: Halo
components.what: 围绕车手头部的保护结构。
components.does: 提供额外的驾驶舱防护。
components.why: 是安全结构，不是内部动力部件。
en: Halo
A protective structure around the driver’s head.
Provides additional cockpit protection.
A safety structure, not an internal powertrain component.

components.name: 座舱
components.does: 提供驾驶操作与车手约束系统的布置空间。
components.why: 布局需要兼顾安全与操作需求。
en: Cockpit
The space occupied by the driver.
Accommodates driving controls and restraint systems.
Its layout must support safety and operation.

components.name: 侧箱
components.does: 容纳冷却相关部件并组织外部气流。
components.why: 冷却需求与空气动力设计需要共同考虑。
en: Sidepods
The bodywork on either side of the cockpit.
Accommodate cooling components and guide external airflow.
Cooling requirements and aerodynamic design interact.

components.name: 底板
components.what: 车体下部的大面积结构。
components.does: 参与产生下压力并组织车底气流。
components.why: 其效果与离地高度和周边流动有关。
en: Floor
The broad structure beneath the car.
Contributes downforce and guides underbody airflow.
Its behaviour depends on ride height and surrounding flow.

components.name: 引擎盖
components.what: 覆盖座舱后方动力区域的外部车身。
components.does: 包覆内部区域并塑造外部气流。
components.why: 外形受冷却和内部布置约束；本模型不展示内部机械。
en: Engine Cover
External bodywork behind the cockpit.
Encloses the powertrain area and shapes external airflow.
Cooling and packaging constrain its shape; this model omits internal machinery.

components.name: 后悬架
components.what: 连接后轮与车体的连杆系统。
components.does: 传递载荷并约束后轮运动。
components.why: 与牵引、轮胎接地和车身姿态相关。
en: Rear Suspension
Links connecting the rear wheels to the car.
Transmit loads and control rear wheel motion.
Related to traction, tyre contact and car attitude.

components.name: 后轮
components.does: 向赛道传递驱动力、制动力和横向力。
components.why: 温度、磨损和载荷会影响可用抓地力。
en: Rear Tyres
The rear tyre and wheel assemblies.
Transmit driving, braking and lateral forces.
Temperature, wear and loads affect available grip.

components.name: 梁翼
components.why: 具体形态取决于技术规则及赛车设计。
en: Beam Wing
Wing surfaces below the rear wing.
Help organise airflow at the rear of the car.
Their shape depends on the technical rules and car design.

components.name: 尾翼
components.what: 赛车后部上方的翼面组件。
components.does: 产生后部下压力，同时带来阻力。
components.why: 其设计需要平衡弯道抓地与直线表现。
en: Rear Wing
The upper wing assembly at the rear.
Generates rear downforce and also creates drag.
Design balances cornering grip and straight-line performance.
